verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
You are the source of the life
I can't be left behind
No one else will do
I will take hold of you

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
I need You Jesus
To come to my rescue
Where else can I go
There's no other name by
Which I am saved
Capture me with grace

verse.name: e1
verse.lines:
This world has nothing to offer
I will follow You
This world has nothing to offer
I will follow You

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Your love makes it worth it
Your love makes it worth it
Your love makes it worth it all
